# BRAC Social Innovation Lab

> BRAC's innovation hub advancing social development through AI, climate adaptation, and frugal innovation across the Global South.

The Social Innovation Lab is BRAC's dedicated research and innovation division focused on designing scalable solutions for development challenges in Bangladesh and beyond. The lab combines human-centered design, frontier technologies, and locally-led approaches to address climate resilience, financial inclusion, and youth employability.

## Key Topics

- Social Innovation Lab
- Locally Led Adaptation (LLA)
- Frugal Innovation
- Climate Resilience
- Anticipatory Action
- AI for Development
- Bangladesh
- Global South
- Human-Centered Design
- Financial Inclusion
- Agricultural Adaptation
- Community Empowerment
- Behavior Change
- Youth Employability
- WASH

## About & Mission

- [Who We Are](https://innovation.brac.net/details/who_we_are_details.php): About page describing SIL mission, team members, and BRAC innovation framework.
- [Social Innovation Lab Homepage](https://innovation.brac.net): BRAC Social Innovation Lab homepage defining organizational mission and global programs.

## Climate & Agricultural Resilience

- [Climate Change Initiatives](https://innovation.brac.net/details/climate_change_details.php): Climate change initiatives using Locally Led Adaptation and AI for agricultural resilience.
- [Social Innovation Partnership](https://innovation.brac.net/details/social_innovation_partnership.php): Climate adaptation partnership using AI and Locally Led Adaptation for resilience.
- [Digital Financial Services Playbook](https://innovation.brac.net/details/digital_finance_playbook_bubble.php): Digital Financial Services Playbook for climate-resilient farming communities.
- [Runway to Frugal Innovation Forum Outcome Report](https://innovation.brac.net/details/runaway_fif.php): Outcome report on AI agriculture and anticipatory action for climate resilience.

## Frontier Technologies & Youth Development

- [Frontier Technology Initiatives](https://innovation.brac.net/details/frontier_details.php): Frontier technology initiatives in youth employability, AI training, and rural development.

## Knowledge & Programs

- [Knowledge Hub](https://innovation.brac.net/details/knowledge_hub_details.php): Knowledge hub featuring Stitch for RMG and behavior change initiatives in Bangladesh.
- [Frugal Innovation Forum](https://innovation.brac.net/details/fif_details.php): Frugal Innovation Forum annual conference for Global South development practitioners.

## Design & Community Solutions

- [Human-Centered Design](https://innovation.brac.net/details/design_details.php): Human-centered design with behavioral nudges for hygiene in Rohingya camps.
- [Crowdsourcing Platform](https://innovation.brac.net/details/crowdsourcing_details.php): bracX crowdsourcing platform for employee intrapreneurship and financial inclusion.
